text: This note concerns the inventory export used by the warehouse team. It follows our discussion about a Monday handover. The shared folder includes the earlier working copy and a dated attachment, so readers can distinguish the current situation from the previous version. The main body is a runbook for diagnosing timeout errors in the inventory export. It gives configuration keys, log locations, rollback commands and a sequence for verifying the deployed service. The closing note mentions the sales team and staff training, but those are downstream readers, not the purpose of this document.
